description: This file defines an abstract Controller class for the Search UI MVC framework in SuiteCRM, handling request processing, redirection, AJAX detection, and JSON response output.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Abstract class providing fundamental request handling and response methods for the search framework's MVC controller.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a view instance.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, routing to specific actions or default display.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the client to a specified URL.

methods.name: isAjax
methods.description: Detects if the request was made via AJAX.

methods.name: yieldJson
methods.description: Sends JSON response data with appropriate headers, handling encoding errors.

methods.name: isActionRequest
methods.description: Checks if the current request corresponds to a defined controller action.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes the requested action name from GET parameters.
